question: Consider the following statements about the Dronacharya Award:1) It includes a cash prize of 10 lakh rupees and a gold statue of Guru Dronacharya.2) O.M. Nambiar received the first Dronacharya Award in 1985 for coaching excellence.Which of the above statements is/are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only statement 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Statement 1:** The Dronacharya Award includes a **cash prize of ₹10 lakhs**, a **bronze statuette** (not gold) of Guru Dronacharya, and a citation. This makes *statement 1 incorrect.*
 
• **Statement 2:** **O.M. Nambiar** was the first recipient of the Dronacharya Award in **1985** for his excellence in coaching. He was recognized for training athletes like P.T. Usha. *Statement 2 is correct.*
 
• The Dronacharya Award is an Indian sports honor presented annually by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** to outstanding coaches.
 
• It was instituted in **1985** to recognize and honor coaches who have produced medal winners in international sports events.
 
• The award aims to promote excellence in coaching and provide recognition to individuals contributing significantly to the development of sports in India.
